# Phase 3B reference capture

`reference.pcap` is generated by the production serializer from synthetic
fixtures in `tests/host/test_pcap.c`. It contains only deterministic local MAC
addresses (`02:...`) and protocol-shaped test bytes; it is not a capture of
real traffic. The fixture set includes beacon, probe request, Data, QoS Data,
Data Null, QoS Null, ACK control, complete EAP-Packet, complete EAPOL-Key,
capture-truncated EAPOL-Key, and four-address WDS Data records.

`expected.tsv` is the independent TShark field table for the reference file.
The CI host job regenerates the PCAP, compares every row with this table, and
uploads the exact file that it inspected. The synthetic truncated EAPOL-Key may
produce a malformed/truncated diagnostic; all other records must not.
